description: This file contains partial class definitions, extension methods, and data models related to Orleans clustering using Consul as the backend. It includes configuration options, validators, registration data structures, and membership table implementations specific to Consul integration within Orleans.

classes.name: ConsulClusteringOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for Consul clustering, including client creation and KV root folder.

classes.name: ConsulClusteringOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validator for Consul clustering options, ensuring configuration correctness.

classes.name: ConsulUtilsHostingExtensions
classes.description: Extension methods for integrating Consul clustering into Orleans hosting builders.

classes.name: ConsulSiloRegistration
classes.description: Data model representing a registered silo in Consul, including hostname, port, status, and suspecting silos.

classes.name: SuspectingSilo
classes.description: Data model representing a silo suspected of issues, with ID and timestamp.

classes.name: ConsulBasedMembershipTable
classes.description: Implementation of Orleans membership table using Consul as the backend store.

classes.name: ConsulGatewayListProvider
classes.description: Provides a list of gateway URIs for Orleans clients, backed by Consul.

methods.name: ConfigureConsulClient
methods.description: Configures the Consul client with a callback or URI and optional ACL token.

methods.name: UseConsulClientClustering
methods.description: Extension method to configure Orleans client builder to use Consul clustering with options.

methods.name: UseConsulSiloClustering
methods.description: Extension method to configure Orleans silo builder to use Consul clustering with options.
